page.overview:
What is You Won't See Me?

You Won't See Me is a song by The Beatles, credited Lennon/McCartney. It was included on the Rubber Soul album.

Paul McCartney wrote the song in the basement music room at 57 Wimpole Street. The Beatles recorded "You Won't See Me" during the last day of recording for Rubber Soul – an all-night session that started at 6 pm on 11 November 1965.
